content:
maya: Heads-up — planning a non-blocking traffic shift to v2 for API routes /v2/generate and /v2/chat at 22:00 UTC tonight. Want to enable a client prober integration as a safety net. Deploy bot config needs a new probe route. TL;DR: small traffic shift, prober validates model compatibility, rollback if error rate >1% for 5m.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment window registered: 2026-04-12T22:00:00Z. Add probe routes under deploy config and tag with canary:true to get 5% traffic. :white_check_mark:

jim: what are the exact probe expectations? CPU? latency thresholds?

maya: probe will send a short chat turn + embedding check. Success criteria:
- 200 within 300ms p95
- semantic match score >0.75 for canned prompt
- no model-mismatch errors (schema mismatch / streaming break)

anika: can we reuse the existing prober job? it currently hits /v1/chat with legacy schema.

maya: prefer a new prober that validates both v1->v2 backward compat. Minimal YAML snippet below:
```
probers:
  v2-compat-probe:
    route: /v2/chat
    payload: {"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize: Redwood inference platform"}]}
    thresholds:
      p95_latency_ms: 300
      semantic_score: 0.75
    clients: [prober-ops, integration-suite]
```

sam: note: mobile SDK still pins to v1 for 2% of tenants. We'll exclude those tenants from the shift via tenant-pinlist.

kai: ops question — what's our rollback trigger exactly?

maya: rollback triggers (automated):
1) 5m error rate > 1% OR
2) running median latency increases by >40% over baseline for 10m OR
3) any client-level contract error observed in prod probes.
Manual rollback can be initiated by @ops.

ops: I'll own the manual rollback call if alerts fire. Ops runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/v2-rollout

deploy-bot: Preflight checks passed: model catalog entry exists (gpt-open-compat-3). Canary pool allocated (4 gpus). Deploybot will shift 2% -> 5% over 15m.

jim: release notes need a short blurb about schema changes for function calling and streaming boundaries — I'll draft and ping docs.

anika: also add note for SRE about KV cache invalidation during warmup. Observability will spike.

maya: good. Plan:
- 21:30 UTC: patch deploybot config + probe job
- 21:45 UTC: schedule canary run in staging
- 22:00 UTC: apply 2% shift
- 22:15-22:30 UTC: increase to 5% if probes green
- 23:00 UTC: hold for ops handback

sam: tagging QA — @qa please run the regression prompt set during canary.

qa: will do. ETA 21:55 UTC.

deploy-bot: NOTE: adding tenant exclusion list: `exclude_tenants: [mobile-p0, gov-test]` — confirm.

kai: confirm, exclude mobile-p0 and gov-test.

maya: final ask — if we see client pins surface, we will route those clients back to v1 immediately; don't wait for automated rollback unless global metrics degrade.

ops: acknowledged.

anika: small nit — add circuit-breaker to client-facing gateway to reduce retries during probe instability.

maya: added to checklist.

deploy-bot: Canary run started: 22:00:30 UTC. 2% traffic shift in progress.

jim: seeing a few extra 429s in edge logs for a subset of tenants — looks like burst. Ops looking.

ops: mitigated by adjusting rate limiter for 2m window. Monitoring.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics (first 5m): error_rate 0.35%, p95_latency 240ms, semantic_score 0.81. All within thresholds. Increasing to 5% over next 15m.

sam: confirm tenant exclusion held.

qa: regression run passed 98/100 tests. Two failures are flaky prompts; will re-run.

maya: thanks everyone. Please stay on slack for the hold at 23:00. I'll post final note for release notes after handback. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canary completed. Handback to ops at 23:02:10 UTC.

ops: handback received. No manual rollback needed. Closing thread once release notes live.

jim: draft release notes in #docs-notes, will link here.

maya: linked notes: https://redwood-internal/docs/releases/1775002468-v2-nonblocking-shift

sam: closing the pin and updating the mobile team about the schedule.

maya: thread closed, thanks all. :tada:
